# External datasets

Remote access was checked on 2026-10-04. See [SETUP_REPORT.md](SETUP_REPORT.md) for results
and `docs/remote-data.md` for the reusable reader. No dataset or media payload is saved
here. The user's preference for remote in-memory access supersedes the older plan's
local samples and clip downloads.

LoVR caption reads and MomentSeeker annotation reads were verified. FORGE is gated;
InspecSafe complete rows were unavailable through the tested Viewer path. No dataset
replaces the human-linked corpus. GEM remains dropped; its empty folder is untouched.
